brief: A portable electronics organizer: a base with removable bins for small parts, at least one drawer, and a carry handle.

requirements.requirement: a base with removable bins for small parts
requirements.evidence: Three bases form structure (piece:0,0,0;full, piece:1,0,0;full, piece:0,1,0;half-n) with three removable bins: two full-depth 2-compartment bins (bin:0,0,0~hex-bin-full-div2, bin:1,0,0~hex-bin-full-div2) and one half-N bin with 2 compartments (bin:0,1,0~hex-bin-half-n-full-div2) - ideal for small electronics parts
drawer:0#0,1#cut installed on the cut face of piece:0,1,0;half-n
handle:1,0,0;top mounted on cover:1,0,0;full;top, providing portable carry

finish.summary: Portable organizer built from 3 bases (2 full hex + 1 half-n). Two full-depth divided bins provide removable storage for small parts, plus a third half-bin in the half-base. A drawer on the half-base cut face adds enclosed storage. A top-mounted handle on a cover provides carry. Checked: meshClash clear, no errors.

notes: Tighten every M6 to 2 N.m: HAND TOOLS ONLY, never a cordless driver. These bolts clamp printed PETG, not metal: at the bolt's own 10.4 N.m rating the head crushes the plastic under it and the joint fails silently, looking tight while holding nothing. Snug, then a nudge. Re-check the bolts after the first few weeks: PETG relaxes under load and the clamp will have eased.
